name: Liam O'Connell
bio:
Liam's journey into the world of motorsport IT began unexpectedly. Originally a systems administrator for a Dublin-based tech firm, he was headhunted by a small rally team needing someone to overhaul their data analysis infrastructure. The raw thrill of race data, combined with the challenge of optimizing performance in real-time, instantly captivated him. He thrives on the pressure of race weekends, ensuring the team has access to the crucial information they need to make split-second decisions.

Since then, he's worked his way up through the ranks, learning the unique demands of motorsport IT at every level. He firmly believes that a proactive and forward-thinking approach is crucial for success. His focus isn't just on maintaining the current systems, but on anticipating future technological needs and developing innovative solutions. He is known to push the boundaries of existing technology to find marginal gains.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Liam is a medium-height man with a focused gaze and a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with coding ideas.
Drinks an absurd amount of green tea throughout the day.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
